criteria.text: The board shows every recorded grout batch in one list on the page.
criteria.note: One list under the header carries all three batches, a line each — B-1041, B-1042, B-1043, with type and colour.

criteria.text: A new batch can be added from the board itself, without leaving the page.
criteria.note: The add row sits on the board itself — a 'new batch code' input with an ADD BATCH button beside it, no navigating away.

criteria.text: The board names itself in a header so the tiler knows what he is looking at.
criteria.note: A full-width orange band across the top reads GROUT TRACKER, exactly as the drawing has it.

criteria.text: The batch list is the first thing under the header.
criteria.note: The batch list opens at y=71, immediately below the header (which ends at y=51) — nothing between them, just as drawn.

criteria.text: An ADD BATCH button sits to the right of the input.
criteria.note: The ADD BATCH button sits at the right end of the row (x=1293), past the input which runs from x=20 to x=1283 — button to the right of the input, as drawn.

criteria.text: A status line beneath the add row shows the current mix ratio.
criteria.note: Your drawing has an orange mix-ratio line ('MIX RATIO 3:1 · 2 BATCHES OPEN') sitting beneath the add row. It isn't there at all — below the add row the page goes straight to a grey footer reading 'grout tracker · sandbox build'.
Your own persistence test ran and went red — it added a batch, restarted, and found the list empty ('the batches were gone after a restart'). The batches do not survive a restart.

criteria.text: The export writes valid CSV with a header row.
criteria.note: Nothing on screen shows an export, and the test run names no CSV or export test — the suite is silent on this, so I could not check it.

gaps.title: the mix-ratio status line
gaps.expected: an orange mix-ratio line beneath the add row
gaps.saw: nothing there — below the add row the page goes straight to a grey 'grout tracker · sandbox build' footer

gaps.title: batches do not survive a restart
gaps.expected: the batches still on the list after a restart
gaps.saw: an empty list — the persistence test found them gone

alsoChecked: The ADD BATCH button is teal (rgb(90,166,184)); your drawing doesn't say what colour it should be, so I'm treating that as the builder's call.
There is a grey footer 'grout tracker · sandbox build' at the bottom; the drawing says nothing about a footer, so that too is the builder's call.
summary: The board runs and the three things you asked for in the PRD are all there — every batch in one list, an add row on the page itself, and a GROUT TRACKER header naming it. Two of the plan's pieces fall short: the orange mix-ratio status line from your drawing is missing entirely — below the add row it jumps straight to a footer — and your own persistence test ran and went red, so the batches don't survive a restart. The CSV export I couldn't check; nothing shows it and no test names it.
